text.en: Most clients praise the salon team for their friendly greeting, accommodating attitude, and thorough attention to pet care. Owners appreciate that groomers take time to discuss styling preferences and share updates during the grooming process. While one brief negative review expressed broad dissatisfaction, the vast majority of visitors recommend the staff warmly.

Pet owners consistently report excellent grooming outcomes, noting that their dogs and cats return looking beautiful and smelling fresh. Several clients highlight skilled dematting, tidy scissoring, and thorough full grooms for long-haired breeds like Maine Coons. Reviewers also appreciate charming extra touches, such as complimentary ribbons and bow ties.

Reviewers emphasize the calm, reassuring treatment given to anxious dogs and feisty cats that dislike brushing. Pet parents note that staff successfully bathed difficult felines and accommodated older pets on quieter days to avoid dog encounters. Clients express relief that their animals returned home feeling visibly relaxed and comfortable after grooming.

q.en: Does Paws Grooming Empire groom cats as well as dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention booking full grooms and dematting sessions for cats, including Maine Coons and feisty felines.

q.en: Can owners request quieter grooming times for nervous pets?

a.en: Reviewers note that appointments on specific days, such as Mondays, can be arranged to ensure a calmer environment without dogs present.

q.en: Do the groomers share updates during appointments?

a.en: Yes, clients mention that staff took photos and videos during the grooming session to show how well their pet was handled.

q.en: Are full grooms and partial grooming services offered?

a.en: Yes, clients report that the salon accommodates both full grooming sessions and tailored compromise grooms for specific needs.
